fitnessSpec.hiking: Strong hiking fitness required — roughly 8-9 miles round trip and ~2,200+ ft of gain to Colchuck Lake, then an additional traverse/scramble above the lake to reach the base, all within a full ~14-16-hour car-to-car day
fitnessSpec.packWeight: Light and fast — single rack, rope, and minimal overnight gear if not camping; roughly 20-25 lbs for a single-push day ascent

partner_requirements.approachTime: Roughly 3-4 hours from the Stuart Lake trailhead to the base of the route (Colchuck Lake Trail, then traversing ~400 ft above the lake toward the west face)
requiredSkills: Confident trad leading through 5.11+ for a short, well-protected crux; the rest goes at 5.10 to 5.11a
Efficient multi-pitch systems (9 pitches) to keep pace with a ~15-hour day
Rappel competence for the single ~30 m summit rappel, including managing rope-pull issues
Route-finding on featured granite with limited fixed protection
Comfort with remote alpine exposure and self-rescue readiness
partner_requirements.experienceLevel: Experienced trad multi-pitch leader comfortable leading sustained 5.10 with a short 5.11+/12- crux; not appropriate for a climber's first alpine multi-pitch outing
